gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-vai: Noto Sans Vai keeps its words in solid, compact blocks. Almendra Display brings ornate, literary flourish and a tall x-height above, while the sans below leaves generous room where curves meet stems.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-thai: Noto Sans Thai has swollen, bead-like lowercase and rounded letters left open. If Audiowide, drawn in one unvarying line, gets shrunk down, its tile-like glyphs and wide gaps lose their futuristic punch.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-thaana: Eater looks dark and aggressive, with wide gaps between letters and short ascenders over a stubby body. Noto Sans Thaana answers in a plain sans with big open lowercase.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Towering like a stubby carpenter's pencil stroke, the lowercase of Flavors looks bent from one wire. Noto Sans Tifinagh fills its lines with rounded, inflated bowls that stay open, so extended reading feels inviting and clean.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Expressive and bold, Autour One draws round letters with no pinching at the curves and a clear channel leading in. Noto Sans Tirhuta follows with cut-back terminals and a dominant x-height, so a long page reads open and contemporary.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-yi: Ornate and bookish, with letters that never pinch shut. Almendra Display excels at literary flourish, whereas Noto Sans Yi, with its deep lowercase midsection and unlatched rounds, is the one built for modern, professional reading.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-ugaritic: Noto Sans Ugaritic keeps capitals and lowercase nearly level, with mouths open like an unjoined chalk arc. Beneath Audiowide's vinyl-cut single line, Noto Sans Ugaritic makes a longer passage feel approachable and clean.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-vithkuqi: Hairline-free thin strokes sit beside moderately weighty stems in Eater, giving it a dark, aggressive look. Noto Sans Vithkuqi sits below it, clean and modern.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-wancho: Whimsical and commanding, Flavors holds every stroke at the same weight, diagonals included. And Noto Sans Wancho thickens into a hulking, chalky lowercase with wide-gapped e shapes, so the two feel like friendly heavyweights.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-warang-ci: Autour One draws round letters with pencil-line consistency and almost no step from capitals to lowercase. And Noto Sans Warang Citi, a sans-serif with wide channels into its counters, would sit fine at a modest size beneath it.
